fields.description: Sandbox for testing (no real money moves); switch to Live only once a real subscription has been tested end-to-end in Sandbox.

fields.description: From the PayPal Developer Dashboard (developer.paypal.com) > Apps & Credentials > your app. Sandbox and Live each have their own separate Client ID.
fields.label: Client ID

fields.description: From the Webhooks section of the same app, after registering this site's webhook URL — used to verify an incoming webhook POST really came from PayPal before trusting it.

fields.description: PayPal does not support VND as a transaction currency — every Billing Plan/Subscription amount is charged in this currency regardless of the tenant's own country.
fields.label: Default Currency

fields.description: Auto-created once by paypal_billing.py on the first ensure_billing_plan() call — the single shared PayPal "Product" every Edition's Billing Plans are nested under. Leave blank; never set by hand.
